non_blocking.finding: B7's failure is still reachable in one way: run_bounded ending while its episode runs. There are three routes. The operator stops run_bounded alone, or signals the runner's process group; the header and note now forbid both. Or run_bounded dies unexpectedly, for example from a crash or an OOM kill, which no document can prevent. In each case the runner reaches finish with the episode alive: through the main 'wait', or through abort()'s elif branch, since kill -0 fails on the dead run_bounded. finish's post-run step then tars, stops and removes the main container under a live worker. Two narrower cases, neither able to remove a live container: (a) a SIGTERM between the launch's '&' and 'LAUNCHER=$!', a window of microseconds, lets the episode start unsupervised after the runner has finished; (b) if run_bounded stays alive without a child for 10 s, which would be pathological, the handler's final 'wait' has no bound.
